description: High Tables: Cho-Han (guess even or odd on two dice, a round every 60 seconds) and Red Dragon (six seats, one takes the pot). Read only: the current round, its pools, the limits, the open tables and, if you pass a wallet, your bets and what you can claim, and whether you hold the Override Disk that new bets and new seats require.

wallet.description: Optional: your 0x wallet, to see your bets, claimable winnings and Disk status.

name: high_table_state
